target_diagnosis.live_model: v1 (enabled 2026-11-09, with a 'check every hit' reminder)
target_diagnosis.criteria: Ready when the model live on the site was tested on real range photos and found at least 90% of the holes with no more than 10% false marks.
target_diagnosis.status_note: 23/11: v1 and v2 tested on all 8 full-res originals. v2 better than v1 (e.g. trigger target ~70%, ring targets up to ~40%) but marks printed digits/logos and misses holes on dark print and torn groups. Far from 90%/10%. Not deployed.
